questions.title: Password Management
questions.pre_condition: The contract must require a documented password standard covering length/strength, secure storage, and rotation.
questions.question: Does the vendor maintain a written password standard that requires at least 14 characters for admin accounts and salted hashing for storage?

questions.title: IT Asset Management
questions.pre_condition: The contract must require an in-scope asset inventory that is reconciled quarterly.
questions.question: Does the vendor maintain an inventory of all cloud accounts and production workloads, and is it reviewed every 90 days?

questions.title: Security Training & Background Checks
questions.pre_condition: The contract must require annual security awareness training and background screening for all personnel with data access.
questions.question: Are background checks and annual security training mandatory for all personnel accessing Company Data?

questions.title: Data in Transit Encryption
questions.pre_condition: The contract must enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for all data in transit over untrusted networks.
questions.question: Does the vendor explicitly commit to using TLS 1.2+ for all external and internal transmissions of Company Data?

questions.title: Network Authentication & Authorization Protocols
questions.pre_condition: The contract must specify MFA for all privileged access and secure pathways like bastions for production.
questions.question: Is MFA required for all administrative access, and is production access restricted to approved bastion hosts with session logging?
